name: 938 -Dead person flower-
source:
If you don't want to talk, you don't have to speak.

If you don't want to hear, you don't have to listen.

If you don't want to see, you don't have to...

You're a high school senior. You lead an ordinary life alongside classmates you don't care about. Suddenly, you become interested in him. Getting closer to him means becoming privy to the darkness dwelling in his heart... Will you be the one to save him?

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080915131713/http://goth.2-d.jp/xx/938.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
如果你不想说话，你就不必说话。

如果你不想听，你就不必听。

如果你不想看，你不必…

你是一名高中生。你和你不关心的同学一起过着平凡的生活。突然间，你对他产生了兴趣。靠近他就意味着了解他内心的黑暗……你会成为拯救他的人吗？

[翻译自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080915131713/http://goth.2-d.jp/xx/938.html]官网[/url]]
